title: state route verb: validated route record + status/preamble surfacing + claim warn (D1-D3)
action: Per CONTEXT D1/D2/D3: (1) packages/bee/lib/workflow-store.mjs: workflow records gain an optional route field {class, lane, flags, product_files, rationale, updated_at}; update path mirrors fx-1's close-transition precedent. (2) New verb bee state route: --set requires --class, --lane, --flags (comma list, may be empty string for zero flags), --files <int>, optional --rationale; validates class in {feature,bugfix,docs,refactor,research,release,spike}, lane in {docs,tiny,small,spike,standard,high-risk}, every flag in {auth,authorization,data-model,audit-security,external-systems,public-contracts,cross-platform,covered-contract-change,proof-weakening,multi-domain}, files a non-negative integer; any violation = typed refusal naming the bad value and the legal set, nothing written; writes to the ACTIVE feature's live workflow record; --show prints the record (and --json). Register in packages/bee/lib/command-registry.mjs beside state.start-feature (:866+). (3) packages/bee/bee.mjs: status --json gains a route block (null when absent); the cells claim handler emits ONE stderr warning line when the claimed cell's feature has no route record — NEVER refuses. (4) packages/bee/lib/inject.mjs buildSessionPreamble: when the active feature has a route, render one line exactly 'Route: class=<c> | lane=<l> | flags=<n> [<names>] | files=<n>'; nothing when absent (ship_visibility precedent). If the state.mjs export allowlist test (EXPECTED_STATE_EXPORTS in packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs) trips on new exports, add them — declared here (sv-1 lesson). Vendored regen DEFERRED (wave-barrier ack).

truths: state route --set with valid values round-trips into the active workflow record; --show and status --json render it.
Each enum violation and a negative/non-integer files value is a typed refusal; nothing written.
claim on a route-less feature warns on stderr exactly once and still claims; with a route, no warning.
Preamble renders the Route line only when a route exists.
prohibitions: Do NOT make claim refuse (D3 soft).

regen_obligation_ack: wave-barrier: regen deferred to orchestrator at wave close (parallel-default D2)

trace.outcome: state route verb (D1-D3): typed-enum validated route record set/show on the active feature's tracked record; status --json + preamble surfacing when present; cells claim soft-warns (never refuses) when a claimed cell's feature has no route.
deviations: Touched packages/bee/tests/test_bee_cli.mjs (not in the cell's declared 6 files) — the new state.route registry entry trips the pre-existing generic 'every registry entry's example must execute at least once' completeness assertion. Added one minimal coverage check (runs examples[0], asserts the round-trip) so the pre-existing test stays green; deeper behavioral coverage (each enum refusal, --show, the D3 claim warning, the preamble line) is explicitly left to et-3 per plan.md. Reserved the file under exec-et1 before writing, no conflict.

Added a belt-and-suspenders direct patch of the underlying workflow-store.mjs record's route field (via updateWorkflowAssumingLock, already holding the lock) in addition to the projection write — satisfies CONTEXT D1's literal 'persists on the ACTIVE feature's workflow record' wording while status/preamble (which read the projection, not the workflow-store file directly) work via the existing ad-hoc-field passthrough mechanism (same precedent as advisor_ref/last_scribing_run/gate_revoked_at). No state-projection.mjs changes needed or made (out of declared scope).

state.mjs was reserved per the cell's declared files but ended up needing no edits — the design needed no new state.mjs export (readLane was already exported, just newly imported into bee.mjs); test_misc.mjs's EXPECTED_STATE_EXPORTS allowlist was unaffected, confirmed by running test_misc.mjs (113/117 pass; the 4 failures are pre-existing baseline red (3, confirmed via git stash of this cell's diff) plus the expected vendored-mirror byte-identity mismatch (regen deliberately deferred to wave close per regen_obligation_ack) — test_misc.mjs is not part of this cell's verify command and both must-have suites named in verify (test_bee_cli, test_state) are fully green.
